note: 1-minute A/B probes run back-to-back on the same host state, to separate data effects from host-load effects.
historical_note: The 2026-09-21 30-minute soak on the same command shape produced 123,611 iterations (14.6 per second). Today the same command produces ~22k per 30 minutes (~12.5 per second) on BOTH snapshots, so the difference is host-state related, not data related; absolute throughput from X86 soaks must not be compared across sessions.
